mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_profile ( tenant_id, account_id, contact_named_num, contact_named_synced_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, account.id, #{contactNamedNum}, #{factAt}, #{writtenAt}, #{writtenAt} FROM account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.id = #{accountId} AND account.deleted_at IS NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE contact_named_num = CASE WHEN VALUES(contact_named_synced_at) > COALESCE(contact_named_synced_at, -1) THEN VALUES(contact_named_num) ELSE contact_named_num END, contact_named_synced_at = GREATEST( COALESCE(contact_named_synced_at, -1), VALUES(contact_named_synced_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
